paragraphs: In the morning, inspectors visit a company to check discharge outlets and hazardous-waste storage and collect samples. In the afternoon, they compare records with permits, verify totals and transfer documents, review the evidence chain, and revise the report. They then meet company managers to set remediation actions, enter the case into the system, organize the follow-up list, and prepare for reinspection.
